title: The Geopolitics of AI Infrastructure - Dylan Patel, SemiAnalysis
talk_summary: It is a macro-industry and policy talk with essentially no software or agent-engineering content.

takeaways.technique: Offload heavy compute to where power/capacity is not the bottleneck
takeaways.evidence_quote: there is a 63 gawatt uh shortfall of power in the US right based on the data centers that we see under construction

takeaways.technique: Reuse idle inference capacity for training-like work
takeaways.what_they_do: Notes that inference clusters at night run reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards to generate trajectories during low utilization.
takeaways.evidence_quote: inference clusters at night in the US are just running reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards generating you know trajectories
